see_for_yourself.expected: Proposals appear under the request with their figures, the request shows Complete, and its confirmed date lands in your calendar.
steps: Create a request and have another member answer it
Propose two free times from the request's page
Confirm one, delete the other, then open the home screen
Tap Download for your calendar and Add to Google Calendar
see_for_yourself.title: Walk a request end to end

what_just_landed.detail: Rehearsals are proposed only from a request's page, and the schedule lists proposals under their request's name; older rehearsals sit under Earlier rehearsals.
what_just_landed.title: Every proposal belongs to a request

what_just_landed.detail: The schedule and the home screen show how many of a request's rehearsals are confirmed, how many members have answered, and when it is complete.
what_just_landed.title: How each request is going

what_just_landed.detail: A complete request offers a download of its confirmed dates and a button that turns on Google Calendar writing.
